"""Original reader execution; the terminal guard receipt writer stays outside the guarded tree."""
import argparse,subprocess,sys
from common import *

def specs():
    raw=local(PRIOR/"qualification-plan.json").read_bytes();value=json.loads(raw)
    need(raw==canonical(value),"complete canonical original prerequisite plan")
    return value["specifications"]

def instrument(spec):
    return {arg:dict(body=(body:=local(arg).read_bytes()).decode(),identity=pin(body))
            for arg in spec["command"] if Path(arg).is_file()}

def filename(attempt,name,suffix):
    need(attempt.isalnum() and name in specs(),"explicit safe original reader role/attempt")
    return "reader-"+attempt+"-"+name+suffix

def qualify(row,spec):
    need(type(row["status"]) is int and row["status"]==0 and row["command"]==spec["command"]
         and row["specification"]==spec and row["revision"]==REVISION
         and row["programmes"]==row["programmes_after"]==programs()
         and row["direct_instruments"]==row["direct_instruments_after"]==instrument(spec),
         "actual unchanged original command, status and complete execution source epoch")
    need(row["stderr"]=="" and spec["match"] in ("whole","terminal")
         and (row["stdout"]==spec["stdout"] if spec["match"]=="whole" else row["stdout"].endswith(spec["stdout"])),
         "complete declared original success stream role")
    for s in ("stdout","stderr"):
        need(local(row[s+"_path"]).read_bytes()==row[s].encode(),"whole retained actual native reader stream")

def child(attempt,name):
    spec=specs()[name];row=load(filename(attempt,name,"-started.json"))
    need(row["specification"]==spec and row["programmes"]==programs(),"whole declared reader and execution programme epoch before child")
    with local(row["stdout_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as out,local(row["stderr_path"],exists=False).open("xb",buffering=0) as err:
        result=subprocess.run(spec["command"],stdout=out,stderr=err)
    actual=dict(**row,status=result.returncode,stdout=local(row["stdout_path"]).read_text(),stderr=local(row["stderr_path"]).read_text(),
                programmes_after=programs(),direct_instruments_after=instrument(spec))
    save(filename(attempt,name,"-actual.json"),actual)
    qualify(actual,spec)

    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

"""Stream every complete fixed Git member and independently check directory closure."""
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import *


def fixed_json(path):
    return json.loads(git('show', REVISION + ':' + str(path)))


def roots():
    selected = set(fixed_json(PRIOR / 'intake-before.json')['roots'])
    selected.update(map(str, (CONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, CUSTODY, SEMANTIC, PRIOR, CLARITY, ADMISSION)))
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if path != other))


def entries(selected):
    raw = git('--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', REVISION, '--', *selected)
    result = {}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = head.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644', '100755') and kind == 'blob' and path not in result,
             'whole ordinary fixed source population')
        result[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    need(all(any(name == root or name.startswith(root + '/') for name in result) for root in selected),
         'every declared source root has complete fixed members')
    return result


def directory_population(selected, population):
    directories = {str(parent) for name in population for parent in Path(name).parents
                   if any(str(parent) == root or str(parent).startswith(root + '/') for root in selected if root not in population)}
    return directories


def graph(selected, population):
    wanted = directory_population(selected, population)
    seen_files, seen_dirs = set(), set()
    for name in selected:
        if name in population:
            local(name)
            seen_files.add(name)
            continue
        local(name, exists=False)
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(name, followlinks=False):
            path = Path(directory)
            local(path, exists=False)
            need(stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode), 'ordinary source directory')
            seen_dirs.add(str(path))
            for child in children:
                local(path / child, exists=False)
            for child in files:
                member = path / child
                local(member)
                seen_files.add(str(member))
    need(seen_dirs == wanted, 'whole source directory population including empty-directory refusal')
    need(seen_files == set(population), 'whole source file population')
    return sorted(seen_dirs)


def derive():
    selected = roots()
    population = entries(selected)
    directories = graph(selected, population)
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    members = {}
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(population.items()):
            path = local(name)
            before = path.stat()
            need(bool(before.st_mode & 0o111) == (entry['mode'] == '100755'), 'complete source executable mode')
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                 and int(header[2]) == before.st_size, 'whole fixed/current source object header')
            remaining = before.st_size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                    need(chunk and stream.read(len(chunk)) == chunk, 'whole fixed/current source bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk)
                    remaining -= len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'complete own source boundary')
            after = path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                 (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns), 'source member epoch conserved')
            members[name] = dict(**entry, bytes=before.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
             'whole fixed Git source stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    need(graph(selected, population) == directories, 'whole source topology epoch conserved')
    task = git('show', REVISION + ':' + TASK)
    return dict(revision=REVISION, owner=OWNER, scope=SCOPE, roots=selected, directories=directories,
        members=members, original_task=dict(identity=pin(task), body=task.decode()),
        retention_contract='fsmgen_required_history',
        recovery='Retrieve complete full-revision Git objects under the repository required-history retention contract; never regenerate native captures.')

"""Admit one exact original default under lower observed resources; retain its terminal."""
import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, 'docs/audits/raw-semantic-reader-completion-20261011')
from common import *
import verify as first
import observe

OUT = Path('docs/audits/raw-semantic-reader-checkpoint-20261011')


def record(name, value):
    path = local(OUT / name, exists=False)
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain first separate continuation record')
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def main(role):
    plan = json.loads(local(OUT / 'plan.json').read_bytes())
    choices = {r: ['python3', '-B', str(p)] for r, p, _ in first.defaults()
               if r in ('construction', 'layout', 'custody', 'semantic')}
    choices['retention'] = first.RETAIN_COMMAND
    logical = 'original-retention' if role == 'retention' else 'after-' + role
    name = plan['selection'][logical]
    body = local(OUT / 'continue.py').read_bytes()
    memory = observe.memory()
    started = dict(owner=LEAF, logical=logical, name=name,
        command=['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'checks.py'), name, *choices[role]],
        programme=dict(body=body.decode(), identity=pin(body)), programmes=first.instruments(),
        admission=memory, plan=identity(OUT / 'plan.json'),
        condition='One original default only, no retry loop. This writer and the first gate writer both remain outside the unchanged child guard. Admission observations are not continuous or peak memory measurements.')
    record(name + '-started.json', started)
    need(memory['occupied_percent'] <= plan['admission_ceiling_percent']
         and first.instruments() == plan['first_programmes'],
         'lower observed resource admission and complete unchanged first instruments before native execution')
    stdout = local(OUT / (name + '.stdout.txt'), exists=False)
    stderr = local(OUT / (name + '.stderr.txt'), exists=False)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(started['command'], stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(), programmes_after=first.instruments(),
        programme_after=pin(local(OUT / 'continue.py').read_bytes()))
    record(name + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(name, 'separate continuation status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0
         and actual['programmes'] == actual['programmes_after'] == plan['first_programmes']
         and actual['programme_after'] == pin(body), 'actual successful unchanged separate original default continuation')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--role', choices=['construction', 'layout', 'custody', 'semantic', 'retention'], required=True)
    main(parser.parse_args().role)

import subprocess
import sys

import verify

import witness
from witness import OUT, save
BASE = OUT

SOURCES = [TASK, verify.BOOK, verify.SURFACES, 'MEMORY.md', 'docs/TASK_TREE.md']


def snapshot(phase):
    rows = {}
    for ordinal, name in enumerate(SOURCES):
        raw = local(name).read_bytes()
        path = local(BASE / ('operation-v3-' + phase + '-' + str(ordinal) + '.gz'), exists=False)
        need(not path.exists(), 'retain first complete publication source snapshot')
        path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0))
        rows[name] = dict(snapshot=str(path), identity=identity(name))
        need(pin(raw) == {k: rows[name]['identity'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')},
             'complete publication snapshot source epoch')
    return rows


def main():
    body = local(BASE / 'operation.py').read_bytes()
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', 'python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'publish.py')]
    started = dict(owner=LEAF, command=command, programmes=witness.instruments(), first_programmes=verify.instruments(),
        programme=dict(body=body.decode(), identity=pin(body)), sources_before=snapshot('before'),
        condition='One exact owned publication operation. The complete terminal writer is outside the standard guard. Every first source, programme, result and stream retains before judgment; only declared task/book/authority/resume/index sources may change.')
    save('publication-operation-v3-started.json', started)
    stdout = local(BASE / 'publication-operation-v3.stdout.txt', exists=False)
    stderr = local(BASE / 'publication-operation-v3.stderr.txt', exists=False)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(), sources_after=snapshot('after'),
        programmes_after=witness.instruments(), first_programmes_after=verify.instruments(), programme_after=pin(local(BASE / 'operation.py').read_bytes()))
    save('publication-operation-v3-actual.json', actual)
    print('publication operation actual status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0
         and actual['programmes'] == actual['programmes_after'] == witness.read('plan.json')['programmes']
         and actual['first_programmes'] == actual['first_programmes_after'] == verify.instruments()
         and actual['programme_after'] == pin(body), 'actual successful unchanged owned publication operation')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

Original native/private/canonical/higher/visual/HIAL/full-CI/push uncertainties and qualifications retain. Focused/book/native/size/claim/staged/normal gates accompany this commit.')
    for key in (OWNER, LEAF):

        final = final.replace(b'  Verification: `' + verify.field(block, 'Verification') + b'`\n',
                              ('  Verification: `' + evidence + '`\n').encode(), 1)
        final = final.replace(b'  Commit: `pending`\n',
                              ('  Commit: `' + LEAF + ': complete unchanged original reader checkpoint`\n').encode(), 1)
        final = re.sub(rb'^  Blocker: `.*`\n', b'', final, flags=re.M)
        if key == LEAF:
            final = final.rstrip() + (
                '\n  Acceptance Checklist (enforced):\n'

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('checkpoint_publisher', OUT / 'publish.py')
    publisher = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(publisher)
    refused = read('publication-operation-actual.json')
    need(identity(OUT / 'publication-operation-actual.json') == read('plan.json')['first_publication_refusal']
         and type(refused['status']) is int and refused['status'] == 1 and refused['stdout'] == ''
         and all(refused['sources_before'][n]['identity'] == refused['sources_after'][n]['identity'] for n in refused['sources_before'])
         and "local(BASE / 'declared-task.md.gz')" in refused['stderr'],
         'whole first publisher path refusal and all unchanged before/after source identities retain')
    second = read('publication-operation-v2-actual.json')
    recovery = read('publication-v2-recovery.json')
    need(identity(OUT / 'publication-operation-v2-actual.json') == read('plan.json')['second_publication_refusal']
         and type(second['status']) is int and second['status'] == 1
         and 'ValueError: owned current task frontier index' in second['stderr']
         and recovery['members'] == recovery['expected'] == {n:e['identity'] for n,e in second['sources_before'].items()},
         'whole second partial publication refusal and exact five-source recovery remain non-success')
    actual = read('publication-operation-v3-actual.json')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', 'python3', '-B', str(OUT / 'publish.py')]
         and actual['programmes'] == actual['programmes_after'] == instruments()
         and actual['first_programmes'] == actual['first_programmes_after'] == first.instruments()
         and actual['stdout'] == 'Prepared complete original-reader checkpoint only; stream recovery and full raw acceptance remain open.\n'
         and first.re.fullmatch(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr']) is not None,
         'whole actual separate successful publication outside original guard')
    snapshots = {}
    names = {TASK, first.BOOK, first.SURFACES, 'MEMORY.md', 'docs/TASK_TREE.md'}
    for phase in ('before', 'after'):
        need(set(actual['sources_' + phase]) == names, 'whole declared publication source population')
        snapshots[phase] = {}
        for name, entry in actual['sources_' + phase].items():
            body = gzip.decompress(local(entry['snapshot']).read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == {k: entry['identity'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
                 and entry['identity']['executable'] is False, 'whole actual publication snapshot body/mode')
            snapshots[phase][name] = body
    for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        need(local(actual[stream + '_path']).read_bytes() == actual[stream].encode(), 'whole actual publication stream')
    row = read('publication-v3.json')
    before = git('show', REVISION + ':' + first.BOOK)
    old = first.read(PRIOR / 'book-size-correction-plan.json')['addition'].encode()
    after = before.replace(old, publisher.ADDITION, 1)
    task = gzip.decompress(local(OUT / 'qualified-task-v3.md.gz').read_bytes())
    need(before.count(old) == 1 and snapshots['before'][first.BOOK] == before
         and snapshots['after'][first.BOOK] == after and local(first.BOOK).read_bytes() == after
         and len(publisher.ADDITION) <= len(old) and snapshots['after'][TASK] == task
         and local(TASK).read_bytes() == task, 'exact sole bounded notice replacement and unchanged task contracts')
    tasks = fixed_sources(row['task_names'])
    tasks[TASK] = task
    books = fixed_sources(row['book_names'])
    registry = git('show', REVISION + ':' + first.SURFACES)
    need(read('task-census-v3.json') == metrics(tasks)
         and snapshots['before'][first.SURFACES] == registry
         and snapshots['after'][first.SURFACES] == first.authority(registry, tasks, books, after)
         and local(first.SURFACES).read_bytes() == snapshots['after'][first.SURFACES],
         'measured task and book authority; unchanged enforcement ceilings')
    return dict(contracts=first.contracts(task), actual=identity(OUT / 'publication-operation-v3-actual.json'),
                book=pin(after), task=pin(task), registry=pin(snapshots['after'][first.SURFACES]))
